## Summary

What this recipe does, for example "train a PyTorch model on one GPU".

## Prerequisites

Account, allocation or group, modules or environment, and data location.

## Job script

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=
#SBATCH --account=
#SBATCH --partition=
#SBATCH --time=
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=
#SBATCH --mem=
#SBATCH --output=%x-%j.out

# load environment

# run
```

## Submit and monitor

```bash
sbatch job.slurm
squeue -u $USER
```
